subject: POC kickoff & capacity planning for Acme Corp - scheduling
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Terry Sullivan <terry@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Jun 2025 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: POC kickoff & capacity planning for Acme Corp - scheduling

Hi Terry —

Great to meet you last week. We'd love to kick off the Acme POC next week with a 90-minute hands-on session: prompt review, routing and model selection, and a short load-test window to validate throughput. Proposed agenda (attached): prompt review (20m), routing & model variants (20m), capacity plan & quotas (20m), hands-on load test (30m).

Proposed times (PT):
- Wed 2025-06-11 10:30–12:00
- Thu 2025-06-12 09:00–10:30
- Thu 2025-06-12 13:30–15:00

For the capacity planning piece we want to cover Dedicated vs Hosted trials, temporary quota bumps (rate limits / token budgets), and the load window for SRE. I've attached the POC agenda and a capacity worksheet you can pre-fill.

Can you confirm which slot works and who from Acme should join (SRE / product)?

Thanks,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan_brooks@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Terry Sullivan <terry@acme-corp.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya@acme-corp.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & capacity planning for Acme Corp - scheduling

Hi Dylan —

Thanks — appreciate the agenda. Thu 2025-06-12 looks better for the team. Can we do Thu 13:30–15:00 PT instead of the earlier slot? Priya (cc'd) is our buyer and will join. I'll also loop in SRE if we confirm the 30m load window.

Two quick questions before we lock the invite:
1) For Hosted trial, what are the default rate limits and token budgets? We may need a temporary bump for the load test.
2) If we decide to try Dedicated for the POC, what's the lead time and minimal committed capacity?

If you can confirm both we can finalize the calendar.

Best,
Terry

Quick internal note —

Terry prefers Thu 13:30–15:00 PT. I'll prepare the load-test checklist and a short docs pack on token budgeting for Hosted vs Dedicated. Alex, can you confirm whether we can provide a temporary hosted rate-limit bump for the 30m load window and by when ops needs the request? I assume 24–48h notice for a soft bump.

Attachments: Capacity-worksheet.xlsx (draft)

I'll also prepare two alternative routing profiles (latency-optimized hosted and our small Dedicated profile) so we can demo trade-offs.

-Marissa

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Terry Sullivan <terry@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 11 Jun 2025 11:30:00 +0000
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & capacity planning for Acme Corp - scheduling

Terry —

Thu 2025-06-12 13:30–15:00 PT is confirmed on our side. I've created a calendar invite (link below) and attached the POC agenda and capacity worksheet.

On the two questions you raised:
- Hosted trial defaults: 60 requests/minute and 400k tokens/day in the trial org by default; for the load window we can request a temporary bump to 300 req/min and 2M tokens/day for a 1–2 hour window. Ops needs a request 24–48 hours before the test to approve.
- Dedicated trial: lead time is typically 2–3 business days for minimal reserved pool (small profile); committed capacity discussions are part of the Dedicated onboarding and we'll cover trade-offs in the meeting.

Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=acme-poc-kickoff-20250612
POC docs: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1POC-Agenda

We will process the temporary quota request once Priya confirms the test window and SRE participants — Marissa, Alex, please create the ops ticket for the rate-limit bump.

Thanks,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Terry Sullivan <terry@acme-corp.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya@acme-corp.com>, SRE Team <sre@acme-corp.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Jun 2025 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff & capacity planning for Acme Corp - scheduling

Thanks, Dylan. Thu 13:30–15:00 PT works for us — Priya and our lead SRE (cc'd) will join. We'll plan the load test for 14:10–14:40 PT (30m). Priya, can you confirm the SRE contact and whether they need a separate network/IP allowlist for the test?

Also attaching our internal security checklist for the POC. Looking forward to the session.

Best,
Terry
